name: thinking
description: Skills that ask instead of answer: one question at a time, so the owner builds the understanding or the structure in their own head. teach-back quizzes you on a document until you can explain it to someone else; ladder decomposes a concept downward or climbs from a symptom up to its purpose, one agreed level at a time. No scripts, no vault dependency. Install at user scope to make it available across all projects.
